messages.subject: plot from fixed value with a fixed slope
parts:
Hi,

I have a working ggplot of a simple data table, 1 value (Y-Axis) for
every day (X-Axis), and I want to add a straight line starting from the
minimum value (which I know to establish) (on day 1) increasing by 1 per
day.

Where can I read up on this?

el

messages.author: f0a4422ce578ee87
messages.subject: Re: plot from fixed value with a fixed slope
parts:
If you want to draw an ad hoc line on ggplot, check out geom_abline(intercept=value, slope=other_value)

Check this link: https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/geom_abline.html

Best.

Walter
